name: todos
description: Shows the repository's TODOs in a band above the prompt, newest first: TODO.md items and TODO/FIXME/HACK code comments dated with git blame, a Mine filter, issue links, and a toast when an edit adds one

show_on_start.title: Show at session start
show_on_start.description: Open the band when a session starts in a git repository that has TODOs. /todos opens it either way.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: How many TODOs the band lists at most; it shows fewer in a short terminal.

markers.title: Comment markers
markers.description: Words that mark a TODO when they open a code comment, separated by commas.

mine_only.title: Only my TODOs
mine_only.description: Start each session with the band filtered to TODOs whose git author is you, or that are not committed yet. The band's Mine and All buttons switch it.
